messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT ALERT • org=surgeplay • high 5xx rate (8.2%) and QPS spike (15k) on api.redwood.ai -> triggered 5xx-rate policy at 12:03 UTC :rotating_light:

alex: paging oncall — seeing 503s from edges. Customer requests are failing. Root hits the per-org rate limiter. request qps 15k, quota 5k. Notified PG.

maria: looking at dashboards now — shard-latency P90 up to 2.1s, requests queued in limiter. KV cache warmups look fine. Most errors are 503 / rate_limited at limiter layer.

cheng: can we do a temporary org override? suggest bump to 20k qps for 20m while they cool down. We'll monitor and revoke if not needed.

alex: I can apply hotfix, but leaving a note: this bypass will let them spike cost-wise. Account ops must notify customer. Executing admin override now:

```bash
# internal admin API (audit logged)
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/orgs/surgeplay/overrides \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"qps":20000,"expires_minutes":20,"reason":"emergency quota bump during spike","runbook_ref":"inc-2074506789"}'
```

alex: returned 200 OK — override_id=ovr-202703 applied by alex at 12:06 UTC. Adding audit tag. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: SYSTEM • quota override applied (ovr-202703) for org=surgeplay by alex — expires in 20m — audit-id=aud-9981

priya_account_ops: pinging customer (SurgePlay) now with the temporary adjustment and ask for expected traffic pattern. Will update thread with reply.

maria: metrics update 12:09 UTC — 5xx down to 1.2%, request latency P95 improved. Limiter drop rate falling. Looks effective so far.

cheng: good. Follow-up actions: 1) keep override for 20m and monitor 2) if traffic stays >15k for >15m, consider throttling to storefront endpoints only or route to smaller-model path to reduce cost 3) create post-incident ticket to review org quota plan and autoscaling rules.

alex: leaving handoff notes — Viv will take over active watch in 10m. I'm stepping off for another page. logs and steps above.

viv_sre: taking over watch at 12:12 UTC. I'll keep eyes on error rate and cost signals. If spike resumes after override expiry, I'll either extend for another 10m or flip to emergency throttling per Cheng's playbook.

priya_account_ops: customer replied: "Thanks — we just kicked off a marketing blast, should be over in ~30 minutes. Appreciate the quick help." passing along convo.

maria: 12:20 UTC status — 5xx at 0.6%, overall qps down to 9k. We should be safe to let override expire but keep alerting.

deploy-bot: AUDIT • recorded override ovr-202703 applied by alex (aud-9981) • config change: org.surgeplay.quota_override=20000 expires=2026-07-02T12:26:00Z • commit=logs/overrides/ovr-202703.json

viv_sre: override expires in ~4m. I'll wait 6m after expiry then close handoff. If error rate spikes back, I'll re-open and escalate to infra+account.

alex: thx everyone. quick postmortem items: add an automated temporary override workflow to reduce manual curl steps, and add a short-template to ping customers when we apply overrides.

priya_account_ops: noted for follow-up. I'll also reconcile billing concerns if their QPS causes overage.

maria: final check 12:34 UTC — metrics stable, 5xx ~0.2%, latency P95 normal. Recommend close incident and record notes in incidents repo with timelines.

viv_sre: closing watch — handing incident to postmortem owner alex for writeup. :thumbsup:
